## Pull requests are closed for now

Thanks for wanting to help. glassy-liquid does not accept pull requests at the moment, and pull requests from outside the project are closed automatically. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/9und30/glassy-liquid/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the reason.

Please open an issue instead:

- [Bug report](https://github.com/9und30/glassy-liquid/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- [Feature request](https://github.com/9und30/glassy-liquid/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)

If you already have a fix, describe the problem in the issue and link your fork or branch.

Security reports go to a [private advisory](https://github.com/9und30/glassy-liquid/security/advisories/new).
